concept.shortdesc: This section describes the Vibration X-axis FFT graph.

conbody.p: This section describes the Vibration X-axis FFT graph.
You can hover on a section of the Vibration X FFT dB graph to view the Vibration X FFT in decibels (dB), the frequency in Hertz (Hz), and the time frame.
